name: Quizlet
shortDescription: Turns notes into practice tests and explains a homework step. Free to start. Paid plans are on their site.
longDescription: Quizlet's AI study tools page says you can turn notes into practice tests, study guides, and flashcards, and that homework help explains a step and adds more practice. The practice-test help page says those tests are currently for science and humanities, with limited free access. Some AI features are free, and Quizlet Plus includes more.
pricingNotes: Some AI features are free. Quizlet Plus includes more. No dollar amount was on the AI tools page.
freeTierNotes: Some AI features are free. Practice tests have limited free access.

weakness: Practice tests are documented for science and humanities, and free access to them is limited.
